title: Detailed lollipop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='popGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b9d'/>
      <stop offset='40%' stop-color='#ff3d7f'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e8175d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c4124a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shineGrad' cx='30%' cy='25%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffadd6' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffadd6' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stickGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f5e6b8'/>
      <stop offset='30%' stop-color='#fff8e1'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#f0dca0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d4c07a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stick -->
  <rect x='46' y='48' width='8' height='40' rx='3' fill='url(#stickGrad)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='48' width='2.5' height='40' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.4'/>
  <rect x='51' y='48' width='2' height='40' rx='1' fill='#c4a850' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- lollipop main circle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='32' fill='url(#popGrad)' stroke='#ff8fb8' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- swirl pattern - spiral swirls -->
  <path d='M 50 36
    C 56 30, 60 22, 54 16
    C 48 10, 38 14, 34 22
    C 30 30, 34 40, 42 44
    C 50 48, 62 46, 66 38
    C 70 30, 66 18, 56 12'
    fill='none' stroke='#ff9ec7' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <path d='M 50 36
    C 44 42, 40 50, 46 56
    C 52 62, 62 58, 66 50
    C 70 42, 66 32, 58 28
    C 50 24, 38 26, 34 34'
    fill='none' stroke='#ff9ec7' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- inner swirl details -->
  <path d='M 50 36
    C 53 33, 55 28, 51 25
    C 48 22, 44 25, 43 29
    C 42 33, 45 37, 48 37'
    fill='none' stroke='#ffc4dc' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- highlight shine -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='24' r='12' fill='url(#shineGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='21' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-20 38 21)'/>

  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='20' r='1.8' fill='#ffe0ed' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#ffe0ed' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='44' r='1.4' fill='#ffe0ed' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='50' r='1' fill='#ffe0ed' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- wrapper crinkle at base of pop -->
  <path d='M 36 60 Q 40 64 50 64 Q 60 64 64 60 Q 58 62 50 62 Q 42 62 36 60 Z'
    fill='#ff8fb8' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
